positiveAssessment: Observer awaits exactly one underlying read, forwards options and returns same value; ordinary error identity retained, no lifecycle change or retry.
Only finite own-data progress fields and completion boolean copied; accessor progress fields are ignored without getter calls; no choices, error text, headers or identifiers emitted.
Failure finally now captures actual compact counts and partial public read progress before save; pending stays visible rather than artificially drained.
Existing financial, privacy and terminal cold comparison assertions retained.

finding.summary: Failure persistence tests truthiness of recoveryError. A falsy original rejection plus save failure loses the original failure value.
finding.scope: Preexisting condition in directly relied-on final persistence path; new90checks cover Error identity only and do not exercise this combination.
finding.requiredRepair: Track explicit failure boolean or tagged outcome; preserve exact original rejection and persistence error together for every thrown value. Add actual-used focused regression including undefined/null/false/0/empty string, original Error, save-only failure and successful persistence. No source-fragment-only surrogate.

limits: lastStep only reports returned public progress; sequence, nextLog and failing internal operation are unavailable. Do not call this exact SDK cursor telemetry.
No full cold run, runtime performance improvement or genuine eligibility from90labelled component passes.
Object descriptors avoid ordinary getters; arbitrary Proxy traps are not a guaranteed supported observation boundary. Current production reader returns owned plain values.
